getStarted.tagline: Private AI that runs on your computer. Chat, tools, agents and energy profiling, no cloud required.
getStarted.serverDown: The server is not responding. It may still be starting up.
getStarted.desktopReady: Your local AI is ready. Everything runs on your device: no data leaves your machine.
getStarted.allRunningDetail: The Ollama inference engine, the API server and the AI model are active.
getStarted.desktopAppHint: One-click install. Ollama and the server come bundled: nothing to set up.

getStarted.browserNote: The chat, dashboard, energy profiling and cost comparison all run locally on your machine.
getStarted.dockerIntro: Use Docker Compose to bring up an instance with zero setup:
getStarted.dockerNote: This starts both the API server and Ollama. The web interface is bundled and served on port 8000.
getStarted.reqCliDetail: Python 3.10+ and an inference engine (Ollama recommended)

source.title: Choose your AI source
source.subtitle: Nothing is installed, started or downloaded until you confirm a choice.
source.ollamaDesc: Runs models on this computer. Asks for a second confirmation before starting Ollama or downloading a model.
source.customDesc: Connect to LM Studio, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, MLX or another compatible endpoint. Ollama stays off.
source.consentBody: Nicx will start Ollama and may download one model selected for this computer. The download can take several gigabytes of disk space and network data.
source.consentBackNote: If you go back, Ollama stays stopped and this choice is not saved.
source.customNote: Nicx only connects after you submit this form. Ollama will not start or download models.
